## ExpiryDebugInfo interface

Human-readable, JSON-serializable diagnostic information describing how a cookie's expiry was derived.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface ExpiryDebugInfo 
```

## Remarks

This object is produced only when the caller explicitly asks for it (via the `expiryDebug` option of [Cookie.parse()](./tough-cookie.cookie.parse.md) or the `setCookie` method of [CookieJar](./tough-cookie.cookiejar.md)<!-- -->). It is never sent in a cookie header and is never included in [Cookie.toJSON()](./tough-cookie.cookie.tojson.md)<!-- -->; retrieving it has no effect on cookie storage or matching behavior.

Every timestamp appears both as epoch milliseconds and a UTC ISO string, so the information is identical regardless of the machine's local timezone.

Note that tough-cookie does not adjust cookies for clock skew: the `clockSkewMs` and `correctedExpiry*` fields are reported for diagnostic purposes only; `expiry` is always the value actually enforced.
